coldStartDiagnostic.condition: No ordinary browser window in a browser on an inactive Windows desktop
coldStartDiagnostic.result: Window metadata unexpectedly restored to normal/focused after a minimized create/update; strict startup assertion failed. Recorded separately, not counted as a passing case or a fixed issue.

limits: Headless samples use ten timed steps after two warmups per condition; headed samples use three timed steps after one warmup. Synthetic 40ms delays apply only to visual message acknowledgements.
Normal headless timings do not establish a universal click speed improvement. Report slow-ack results separately from normal operation, model inference and external websites.
The first batch includes a compatibility check; its one model tool call can still issue three CLI commands for two steps. Every step retains native validation and synchronization.
Headed input on the inactive Windows desktop retains native input acknowledgement and renderer frame readiness waits. Those safety checks were not removed to improve measurements.
The passing headed scenario includes an independent ordinary browser window and verifies it remains untouched. The separate no-window cold-start anomaly needs additional investigation.
Idle preview uses a five-minute service-clock advance and a real daemon with two-second idle setting; normal default ten-minute timing was not waited out.
Older tested extensions remain input-compatible but cannot provide new asynchronous status or detailed cleanup receipts.
Two external DeepSeek Flash review attempts returned empty final content at their output limit; neither is counted as a successful review. Validation here comes from source audit and local tests.
